versions.changelog: v1.0.3 - brand promo link updated to https://www.xiaoyaosai.com/ (docs-only change: SKILL.md bilingual promo line; no behavior change).
Docs only: replaced the XiaoyaoClaw promo line in SKILL.md with a bilingual XiaoyaoAI promo block (Chinese + English, project.xiaoyaosai.com). No functional, script, or metadata changes.

- Updated configuration modification behavior: now prompts the user for confirmation before applying changes (e.g., to agents.list or agentToAgent.allow), ensuring no unauthorized configuration edits.
- Simplified agent roster management by removing user-editable agent-roster and related files; all agent listing references now use agents.list from the config.
- Updated documentation and examples to clarify that configuration changes use config.patch only with explicit user approval, never config.apply.
- Scripts and documentation were revised to streamline OpenClaw config detection (prefer runtime config, prompt if missing) and clarify usage.
- Removed obsolete files: skill-card.md and templates/agent_roster.md, reflecting the shift in agent roster management.

xiaoyaoclaw-agent-orchestrator 1.0.0 initial release:

- Introduces a multi-agent orchestration framework for OpenClaw, enabling task splitting, agent dispatching, progress tracking, result aggregation, and failure retry (up to 3 times).
- Reads and respects openclaw.json for agent rosters and agent-to-agent permissions, enforcing user control over configuration changes.
- Incorporates a three-tier trigger mechanism to prevent unwanted automation: executes explicitly, suggests on big/fuzzy tasks, remains silent otherwise.
- Handles all agent communication via sessions_send and summarizes results with clear source attribution.
- Offers detailed user guidance, transparent operation boundaries, and supports both Windows and macOS without external dependencies.
